wholePhysicalScope: The public entrance in the photographer’s own November 2024 CC0 image, registered within the separately named palace and museum outline.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open twin arcade, recessed porch, raised niche and public wing. Near levels add painted relief, moldings and lettering.
limitations: The single photograph records the November 2024 public entrance. The rear wall, roof, side returns and depth are approximated. The scope covers the public entrance wing and immediate porch.
The open arches, powder-blue sign band, muted painted relief and raised niche follow the photographed façade. Small text and figurative detail are simplified.

Camera position, its recorded pointing direction and photograph-derived scale locate the wing within the mapped palace compound. Width, center and bearing remain approximate. The original independent elevation field is preserved.
